name: Constitution Guard
description: Blocks Archibald from writing, deleting, or unlocking SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, or SECURITY.md, tampering with Hard Stop state, or changing OpenClaw's own settings (openclaw.json, exec-approvals.json, openclaw config/plugins/approvals/channels/pairing commands). Archibald proposes; the user applies. Backed by chflags uchg on the constitution files.
